description_en: Retrieves a token that is used as an authorization credential when calling APIs to access enterprise data
description_zh: 通过调用本接口获取 token，调用接口获取企业数据时，需要使用该 token 作为授权凭证
name: CorpToken

parameters.help_en: The enterprise agent ID, which is used to establish the bindingrelationship between the enterprise and the application. For information about how to obtain it, refer to: Callable Enterprises (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667765)
parameters.help_zh: 企业代理 ID，用于建立企业与应用的绑定关系，获取方式请参见：可调用企业 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667765)
parameters.name: corp_id

parameters.help_en: Required. The API secret key of the application. For information about how to obtain it, refer to: Application Basic Information - Application Credentials (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667763)
parameters.help_zh: 必填项，应用的 API 接口密钥，获取方式，请参见：应用基础信息-应用凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667763)
parameters.name: app_secret

expire.description_en: The token validity period. The default value is 2 hours (7200000 ms). To prevent token expiration, set the refresh interval to: 5 minutes ≤ interval ≤ 2 hours. If you refresh within this interval, the token obtained from the previous request remains valid
expire.description_zh: token 的有效时长，默认为 2 小时（即：7200000ms）。为防止 token 失效，建议每次刷新的间隔为： 5 分钟 ≤ 间隔 ≤ 2小时。 在此间隔内刷新，上一次请求获取到的 token 仍然有效

expire.title_zh: 过期时间，单位ms，token在存储时，不要接近expire的时间，最好远小于expire

start.description_zh: token 的生效起始时间，短时间内重复请求，本字段数值不变
